source: PROVISIONAL. Decision A11 (docs/plans/v2.5/decisions-sheet.md) says the user writes the three one-line premises; that cell is still empty on 2026-09-30. Replace these three with the user's before the first measured run, and commit the change before the run (overview rule 4).

premises.text: A courier must cross a flooded city before the tide turns, carrying a parcel two rival guilds both want.
A disgraced knight escorts a heretic to her trial and slowly learns the charges against her were invented.
Three strangers wake in a lighthouse keeper's cottage with no memory, and the keeper insists they have been here before.

W1.measure: steps whose call parsed and validated on the first try / all steps, per route

W2.measure: finished stories whose final draft passes parseStoryV2 with 0 errors / finished stories

W3.measure: accepted / proposed writes over the 3 premises (refused calls are not proposals)

W4.measure: each generated story plays 30 turns on a lane with >= 2 transitions and no stall

W6.measure: blind-rating pack: agent story preferred over the staged wizard's on the same premise
